writtenBy: AI assistant (Claude Opus 5.5), at the builder's request

rows.text: Team 1 finished AB, full sweep, nothing found.
Cleared AK and AN along the road, no sign of him.
Footprints in the mud by the creek in AF, small shoe, heading downstream.
A jogger says she saw a boy in a blue hoodie on the trail in CJ about 20 minutes ago.
Subject found sitting at the picnic shelter in BH. Bringing him back now.
Picked up a pink mitten on the trail in BC.
Radio check from Team 3, moving to staging.
Cleared CB and CC around the pond edge, nothing.
Candy wrapper and a broken branch in the thick brush in AV.
Man on a bike saw a kid alone near the restrooms in AZ.
Found a water bottle with a name sticker at the edge of the open field.
Done with BM, hasty search only, about 40 minutes, 3 searchers.
Heading back to command, my radio battery is low.
A dog walker saw a woman in a green coat walking along the lake shore in BS.
We have him. Subject located in the woods in CE.
Fresh drag marks and a tissue in the drainage ditch between AH and AI.
Searched the trees in CK and CL, voice and visual, nothing heard.
Not sure what we saw, something moved behind the shed in AC, checking.
Cleared BX along the creek, about 80 percent coverage.
Old campfire ring under the big rock outcrop in BK, ash still warm.
